config.onekeyminer.title: OneKeyMiner Configuration
config.onekeyminer.option.activation_mod: Choose how chain actions are activated.
config.onekeyminer.option.shape_mode.too: Choose the shape used to collect mining targets.
config.onekeyminer.option.max_blocks.too: Maximum number of targets in one chain action.
config.onekeyminer.option.max_distance.t: Maximum search distance from the origin.
config.onekeyminer.option.consume_durabi: Allow chained mining to consume tool durability.
config.onekeyminer.option.stop_low_durab: Stop before the tool reaches the reserved durability.
config.onekeyminer.option.preserve_durab: Minimum durability to keep before stopping.
config.onekeyminer.option.consume_hunger: Apply exhaustion for successful chained actions.
config.onekeyminer.option.min_hunger.too: Stop when the food level reaches this value.
config.onekeyminer.option.mine_all.toolt: Allow blocks not rejected by the configured blacklist.
config.onekeyminer.option.allow_bare_han: Allow chain mining without a held tool.
config.onekeyminer.option.enable_interac: Enable chained tilling, stripping, shearing and similar interactions.
config.onekeyminer.option.enable_plantin: Plant eligible neighboring cells with the held item.
config.onekeyminer.option.harvest_replan: Consume a seed and restore the harvested crop.
config.onekeyminer.option.teleport_drops: Move new chain-action drops to the player or inventory.
config.onekeyminer.option.teleport_exp.t: Give new chain-action experience directly to the player.
config.onekeyminer.option.play_sound.too: Play feedback sounds for successful chain actions.
config.onekeyminer.option.strict_match.t: Require matching block states when collecting targets.
